identification: Lot 1123 is the centre slab of three leaning on corrugated iron (1124 left, 1122 right), chalked 20/11/26. Rough-sawn live-edge slab, pale straw to honey, bark and voids on both edges, ripple figure and some knot clusters. Catalogued SLAB OF HUON PINE; species not verifiable from photo and it could be celery-top or another pale Tasmanian softwood. Size by eye roughly 1.8 to 2 m long and 25 to 35 cm wide (narrower than its neighbours). No description. Gowans sells these routinely under the same title.

viewing_check: Scratch an edge and smell it (huon pine has a strong sweet oil aroma), check end grain for very tight rings, measure length, width and thickness, and check cracks and the extent of bark voids. If open grain and no aroma, treat as plain slab.
